title: Identify users who earned a badge in 2013 and own at least one well-finishe
question: Identify users who earned a badge in 2013 and own at least one well-finished post (i.e., not closed) that has more favorites than the average favorite count of all posts. Return their display names along with the title of such a post.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_055", T2."XCL_035"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN badges AS T3 ON T1."XCL_052" = T3."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T3."XCL_004") = '2013'
  AND T2."XCL_044" IS NULL
  AND T2."XCL_039" > (SELECT AVG("XCL_039") FROM posts)
